# Input

<!-- Generated by scripts/sync-component-docs.mjs from ai/component-catalog.json and ai/component-composition.json. Do not edit; run `npm run catalog:sync`. -->

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-input` · Web Awesome · component · Forms · recommendation: avoid

## When to use

Ecosystem text input; use Kerf TextField.

- Text input with labels, hints, clear controls, and semantic appearances.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use TextField for free text; use TokenSearchField only when text and ordered filter tokens form one editor.

**Alternatives:**

- [TextField](./text-field.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use TextField for free text; use TokenSearchField only when text and ordered filter tokens form one editor.
- [TokenSearchField](./token-search-field.md) (prefer-kerf) — Use TextField for free text; use TokenSearchField only when text and ordered filter tokens form one editor.

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/input/input.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-input>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

## Props

Typed JSX attributes: [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md) (import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome` for types only). Use the Web Awesome attribute API; do not reach into its shadow DOM.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.
- Built from: [Icon](./wa-icon.md).

## State and wiring

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: self · padding: self (layout role: forms). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

## Accessibility

No component-specific obligations beyond native semantics and a visible or accessible name for every control.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
